# AegisLex — Phase 3: Risk Assessment

## Risk Level: LOW

All changes are additive (new translation keys) or substitutive (replacing string literals
with `lang.t()` calls). No logic, data flow, or structural changes were made.

---

## Change Risk Matrix

| Change | Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| New keys in `TRANSLATIONS` dict | None | Additive only; existing keys untouched |
| `inject(LanguageService)` in dashboard TS | None | Already used across all other components |
| `lang.t()` replacing string literals | Minimal | Falls back to EN if key missing; falls back to key name if neither language has it |
| `getStatusLabel()` new method | Minimal | Falls back to raw `status` string if key not found — identical to previous behaviour |
| `formatDate()` locale change | Minimal | `toLocaleDateString` with `'ar-AE'` locale is fully supported in all modern browsers; falls back gracefully |
| `greeting` computed now calls `lang.t()` | None | Signal is computed — same reactivity pattern |
| `statCards` computed labels now `lang.t()` | None | Signal is computed — same reactivity pattern; only the label string changes |
| `aria-hidden="true"` on icon elements | None | Improves accessibility, doesn't affect visual rendering |
| `[attr.aria-label]` added to buttons/links | None | Purely additive HTML attribute |
| SCSS | None | **Untouched** — verified byte-identical |

---

## Potential Issues — None Found

- Mock mode: ✓ Not affected — `mockActivity` array is unchanged; `MockService` is unchanged
- Demo mode: ✓ Not affected — auto-authentication flow unchanged; dashboard data unchanged
- Routing: ✓ Not affected — `routerLink` values unchanged
- State (NgRx): ✓ Not affected — no store interactions in dashboard component touched
- AI preparation (Grok/Gemini): ✓ Not affected — no AI service calls in dashboard
- Backend preparation: ✓ Not affected — `DashboardService` unchanged
- Performance: ✓ `lang.t()` is a synchronous dictionary lookup — negligible cost
- Memory: ✓ No new subscriptions, no new `effect()` calls, no new `setInterval`/`setTimeout`

---

## Rollback Plan

If any issue is found, rolling back requires reverting 3 files:
1. `language.service.ts` — remove the 38 Phase 3 keys (lines clearly marked `// ── PHASE 3`)
2. `dashboard.component.ts` — revert to Phase 2 version (remove `LanguageService` injection + 13 `lang.t()` calls)  
3. `dashboard.component.html` — revert to Phase 2 version (29 bindings → raw English strings)

The SCSS does not need rollback as it was never modified.
